question: ACCELERATOR_DISPATCH_IS_NOT_THE_COST measured the mlp gate_up PAIR lever at 17.35 us per removed dispatch against 2.64 and 2.86 for three other levers, ruled out host and DRAM bandwidth, and said in its own claim boundary that the experiment which would settle it -- a kernel that fuses the dispatch while still loading the input twice -- DOES NOT EXIST AND WAS NOT BUILT. Built.

THE_CONTROL_AND_WHY_IT_IS_HARD_TO_BUILD.arms: two kernels, ONE dispatch each, SAME weights read, SAME output, SAME grid and threadgroup. The ONLY difference is whether the input slice is loaded once and fed to both accumulators, or loaded twice.
THE_CONTROL_AND_WHY_IT_IS_HARD_TO_BUILD.the_difficulty: a naive x[i] read twice is common-subexpression-eliminated by the Metal compiler and would have measured NOTHING while looking like a control. The reload arm therefore passes THE SAME MEMORY as two SEPARATE `device const float*` parameters -- without `restrict` the compiler cannot prove they alias, so it cannot fold the second load away.
THE_CONTROL_AND_WHY_IT_IS_HARD_TO_BUILD.shape: 17408 x 5120, group 64, affine_q2 -- the artifact's real MLP gate/up shape, not a toy

CORRECTNESS_FIRST.oracle: float64 over the same packed bytes, independent of the kernel
CORRECTNESS_FIRST.note: identical to the last digit, which is what proves the two arms compute the same thing

THE_REGIME_CROSS_CHECKS_AGAINST_UNRELATE.independent_comparison: ACCELERATOR_EXPERT_BATCH measured a native q4 arm at 161.9 GB/s on this machine and concluded it was ARITHMETIC-BOUND ON THE UNPACK rather than near the bandwidth wall
THE_REGIME_CROSS_CHECKS_AGAINST_UNRELATE.why_it_matters: a synthetic kernel is only evidence about production if it sits in the same regime. 149.9 against 161.9 from a different experiment on a different day says it does -- and it also predicts the result below, because a kernel bound on shifts and masks does not care about one extra L1 load.

PREDICTION_WRITTEN_BEFORE_THE_RUN: if operand reuse is the mechanism, `reuse` beats `reload` by 8-20% at the real MLP shape. If the two are INDISTINGUISHABLE, operand reuse is REFUTED and the win lives in the prologue, occupancy or the compiler -- candidates F, G and K of S032 §5.
OUTCOME: REFUTED, AND NOT IN THE PREDICTED-NULL DIRECTION EITHER

measured.gate: pre-registered: machine_quiescence sampled before AND after each sweep, admitted only with no process over 2 GiB RSS at either sample; observed max_rss 0.13-0.15 GiB
measured.sign_consistency: reload is faster in 3 OF 3 admitted sweeps
measured.HOW_STRONG_THIS_IS_AND_HOW_STRONG_IT_IS_: the arms carry ~15% IQR, ABOVE the 10% gate, so NO small effect is resolved in either direction and none is claimed. What IS settled is the prediction: an 8-20% advantage for `reuse` cannot hide when the medians differ by -1.9% and the sign is consistent 3/3 in the WRONG direction. The hypothesis is refuted at the size it was proposed at.

eliminated: E register/threadgroup reuse -- OF THE INPUT VECTOR, which is the specific form the previous receipt proposed
L producer-consumer staying in a faster hierarchy -- for the INPUT, same measurement
WHAT_THIS_ELIMINATES_FROM_S032_5_S_THIRT.and_the_mechanism_for_the_elimination_is: the kernel does 8 shift-and-mask unpacks plus 2 fused multiply-adds per byte pair. Against that instruction stream one extra L1 load is free, which is exactly what an arithmetic-bound-on-the-unpack kernel predicts -- and the 149.9 GB/s cross-check says this kernel is that.
NOT_eliminated_and_the_control_did_not_t: F kernel prologue/epilogue -- the production unfused path pays TWO dispatch prologues
K compiler optimization unlocked by fusion

THE REDUCTION AND EPILOGUE: production unfused does two SEPARATE simd_sum, threadgroup reduces and writes; fused does two accumulators in ONE reduction pass. This control held the reduction FIXED at two accumulators in both arms, so it says nothing about that difference -- and that difference is now the leading candidate.
WHAT_THIS_ELIMINATES_FROM_S032_5_S_THIRT.honest_status: two of thirteen eliminated by measurement, none confirmed. That is less than the steer asked for and more than an untested story.

THE_ARM_THAT_WOULD_SETTLE_IT_IS_BLOCKED_.what: a THREE-arm run adding `two_dispatch` -- a single-accumulator kernel run TWICE, which is exactly the shape the unfused production path executes, against the one-dispatch dual-accumulator fused shape. That isolates prologue + reduction + epilogue together.
THE_ARM_THAT_WOULD_SETTLE_IT_IS_BLOCKED_.why: the run's own pre-registered gate returned NO ADMITTED SWEEP inside a 1300 s budget -- BENCH_STATE = CONTENDED. tools/mlx_boot.py from the operator's Personal-Model held 45.6 GiB throughout and was NOT killed, on the same rule as the lake fill.
THE_ARM_THAT_WOULD_SETTLE_IT_IS_BLOCKED_.the_gate_working_is_the_point: S032 §3 says an unknown machine is not a quiet one and a contended arm may not be silently compared to an uncontended one. The harness refused to produce a number rather than producing one nobody could audit, and that refusal is recorded as the result of the run.
THE_ARM_THAT_WOULD_SETTLE_IT_IS_BLOCKED_.exact_missing_input: a quiesced window of about 90 seconds with no process over 2 GiB RSS

claim_boundary: SYNTHETIC KERNEL, NOT THE PRODUCTION ONE. It reproduces the shape, the codec, the group size and the regime (149.9 vs 161.9 GB/s) but it is my reimplementation, and the production kernel is faster than mine -- 64 of my dispatches would be 23.7 ms against a whole token of 28.02, which cannot be right, so production is doing something mine is not.
the arms carry ~15% IQR, above the program's own gate; the refutation rests on SIGN CONSISTENCY 3/3 plus a median in the wrong direction, not on a clean gate, and no small effect is resolved.

ONE shape, ONE machine, INSTANCE. Random codes and scales rather than the artifact's real weights -- correct for a timing question, since the instruction stream does not depend on the values, and NOT correct for anything about adequacy.

the reload arm's defence against common-subexpression elimination is ARCHITECTURAL (two unaliased parameters) and was not verified by reading generated assembly, which xcrun metal being ABSENT on this machine makes impossible -- the same named gate that blocks AOT metallib.
NOTHING about the production 17.35 us/dispatch figure moves: this refutes one proposed MECHANISM for it, not the measurement.
